props.gloss_en: Shmuel: unfit sekhakh in the middle invalidates at four [tefachim]

Rav (Nehardea version): both at the side and in the middle, four amot
the mishnah (14a): if he put on it a board four tefachim wide, it is valid
two sheets combine
two boards do not combine
R' Meir: boards are like sheets [they combine]
the stam names the Sura version as Rav's: unfit sekhakh in the middle invalidates at four tefachim

less than four wide -- R' Meir invalidates
and R' Yehuda validates

with skewers -- it is not a diminishing
the stam: and this [Abaye's rule] applies at the side
one said: lavud applies in the middle
and one said: lavud does not apply in the middle

the baraita: an alleyway beam projecting from one wall short of the other, or two beams from opposite walls not touching -- less than three [tefachim] apart, he need not bring another beam; three, he must

the mishnah: a skylight with an opening of a tefach -- impurity in the house, all of it is impure but what is opposite the skylight is pure; if the skylight has no opening of a tefach, with impurity in the house, what is opposite the skylight is [still] pure
R' Yehuda bar Ilai expounded: a breached house roofed over -- valid
R' Yishmael b. R' Yosei: Rebbi, specify -- thus Father explained: four amot, invalid; less than four amot, valid
R' Yehuda bar Ilai expounded: the avroma fish is permitted
R' Yishmael b. R' Yosei: Rebbi, specify -- thus Father said: that of such-and-such a place is forbidden, that of such-and-such a place permitted
Abaye: the small fish (tzachanta) of the Bav river are permitted
proposed: because the water runs fast, and an unclean fish, lacking a spinal cord, cannot stand in it
proposed: because the water is salty, and an unclean fish, lacking scales, cannot stand in it
rather: because their mud does not breed unclean fish
Ravina: and now that the Eitan and Gamda rivers pour in there, they are forbidden
